caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl or plate viewed from above, with a centered symmetrical design. In the middle, there is an image of a two-headed bird facing outward, painted in shades of gray and beige with black and yellow highlights on the beaks and tail. The bird stands against a brown background encircled by a yellowish border with wavy patterns. Surrounding the central bird is a broad decorative border featuring intertwining green, yellow, and white botanical or vine-like motifs that repeat around the rim, interspersed with flower-like elements. The overall composition is circular, with earthy brown, yellow, green, white, and black dominating the color scheme. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, and there is a small, neat signature in the lower right corner of the plate's exterior.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
